verses.text: Yowalil sko xajanej Jehová ko Diosal, sko k'anab'ajan tas schek ko k'ulej t'a masanil tiempo, haton sk'ayb'ub'al, scheknab'il yet' skachnab'il.

Sko naek tiknaik tas ix yutej Jehová onh skachani. Ha onh tik ix kila', manhok heb' kuninal ix ilan tas ix sk'ulej Jehová chi'. Ha onh wal tik ix kila' jantak sniwanil yelk'ochi yet' spoder yet' tas satub'tak ix sk'ulej.
Kilnak tas sk'ulejnak Jehová t'a winh sreyal Egipto yet' t'a masanil heb' anima kajan ta'.

Kilnakpax tas sk'ulejnak yet' heb' soldado winh rey chi' yet' jantak carruaje yet'nak nok' chej. Masanil juntzanh chi' mukchajnakkanb'at yuj Jehová t'a yol ha' Chakchak Mar ayik onh spechan heb', yuj chi' a ko Diosal chi' satannakel heb' t'a junelnhej.
Sko naekpaxkoti jantak wach'il sk'ulejnak Jehová chi' t'ayonh t'a tzinan lum masanto onh jawi t'a tik.

Sko naanpaxkoti tas sk'ulejnak yet' winhaj Datán yet' winhaj Abiram yuninal winhaj Eliab, t'a yinhtilalkan Rubén. Spojnak sb'a lum lum t'a snanhal ko campamento, mukchajnakkanem heb' yet' masanil yuninal, masanil tas ay t'a heb', smantiado heb', schekab' heb' yet' nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'. Icha chi' ajnak satel heb' yuj Jehová t'a kichanh.
Ha onh tik testigo onh t'a masanil tas sk'ulej Jehová to satub'tak yilji.
Yuj chi', k'anab'ajejek scheknab'il Jehová swak'kan tik t'ayex, yik wach' tz'och wal eyip tzex b'at kajan t'a sat lum lum wan yoch eyikok chi',
yik wach' pax najtil ol ex kajnaj t'a lum lum te yax sat chi', haton lum yak'nak sti' Jehová yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham yet' t'ayonh a onh yinhtilal onh heb' tik.
Ha lum wan yak'ji chi' t'ayex, manh lajanok lum icha lum Egipto b'aj onh koti. Ha t'a Egipto chi' slajwi eyawan tas tzeyawej, tzeyak'anoch yalil icha b'aj tz'awchaj anh itaj.
Ha pax lum b'aj wan he k'och chi' jun, ay switzal lu'um. Ay pax spanhanil lu'um, aynhejoch yal lu'um yuj nhab' syak' Jehová.
Ha jun lum chi' tanhwab'il lum yuj Jehová, aynhejoch sat t'a lu'um tzek' ab'il.
Yuj chi', k'anab'ajejek scheknab'il Jehová, haton juntzanh wan walan tik t'ayex. Tze xajanej Jehová ko Diosal, tzeyak'em he b'a t'ay t'a smasanil he k'ool yet' smasanil he pensar.
Tato icha chi', ol yak'nhej b'ab'el nhab' yet' slajwub'xo, yuj chi' te wach' ol aj sat eyawb'en, he trigo, te' eyuwa yet' te' eyolivo.
Ay pax yax ank'ultak ol swa nok' he molb'etzal nok', ol ste ak'ej sat tas ol eyawej yik wach' ay he wael.
Palta tzeyil wal he b'a, yik malaj junok mach tzex montanb'ati yik tzeyik'anel he b'a t'a spatik Jehová, haxo talaj t'a juntzanhokxo komon Dios tzex och ejmelal, tzex och tzak'an yuj.

Tato icha chi', ol kot yowal sk'ol Jehová chi' t'ayex. Manhxo ol yak'laj nhab', manhxo ol yak'laj sat masanil eyawb'en, haxo he cham yuj wejel t'a sat lum lum te yax sat wan yak'an Jehová chi' t'ayex.
Scham wal eyab'ankan juntzanh lolonel tik, tze sik'ankan t'a he pensar. Tzek'ekoch t'a he k'ab' yet' t'a snanhal he sat.
Ha juntzanh tik ol eyak' sk'ayb'ej heb' eyuninal t'a junjun k'u. Ayexnhejoch eyalan t'a heb', ayik ayex ek' t'a he pat, ayik tzex b'ey t'a yoltak b'e, ayik tzex wayi, ayik pax tzex k'e waan.
Tze tz'ib'anoch t'a smarcoal spuertail he pat yet' t'a spuertailtak he chonhab',

yik wach' ol najatb'ok he k 'inal yet' heb' eyuninal t'a sat lum lum yak'nak sti' Jehová ko Diosal yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham. Ol ex kajnajnhej ta' yakb'an ayek' satcha'anh t'a yib'anh lum lum tik.
Tato tze k'anab'ajej masanil juntzanh cheknab'il swalkanel tik t'ayex, tze xajananpax Jehová ko Diosal, tze k'ulan masanil tas syala',
ichato chi' b'ian, a Jehová chi' ol ik'anel juntzanh chonhab' te niwak, te ay pax yip t'a eyichanh, a exxo ol ex kajnajkan t'ay.
Masanil lum b'aj ol ex ek'ok, heyik ol ajkan lu'um, sb'atnhej lum t'a takinh lu'um masanto sk'och t'a Líbano. Sb'atnhej lum t'a ha' niwan Éufrates masanto sk'och t'a ha' mar Mediterráneo.

Malaj mach ol yal stek'b'an sb'a t'a eyichanh. Ha Jehová ol ak'anoch niwak xiwk'olal t'a skal anima b'aj ol ex ek'nhej, manhxo ol yal snaan heb' tas ol yutok skolan sb'a heb' t'ayex icha ix aj yak'an sti' Jehová chi' t'ayonh.
Ab'ek jun, ha t'a jun k'u tik swak' he sik'lej, tom a swach'k'olal Jehová tze nib'ej mato a skatab'.
Ol he cha swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal tato tze k'anab'ajej scheknab'il wan walan tik t'ayex.

Ha yowal sk'ol ol kot t'a eyib'anh tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej juntzanh cheknab'il tik, tato tzeyik'el he b'a t'a Jehová, tzeyak'anoch he pensar t'a juntzanh komon Dios to manh eyojtakok, tzeyak'anem he b'a t'ay.
Ayik toxo ix ex k'och t'a sat lum lum chi' yuj Jehová ko Diosal, haton jun lum wan yak'an t'ayex, ol eyalanel wach' lolonel t'a yich lum witz Gerizim yet' katab' lolonel t'a yich lum witz Ebal.

Ha juntzanh lum witz chi', ha t'a yichanhek' niwan b'e ay lu'um, tzek' t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán, t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, b'aj ay sluum heb' cananeo, heb' anima ay t'a yak'likal sti' ha' niwan Jordán t'a yichanhb'at Gilgal. Jun b'aj ay te' ji t'a yol yik More.
Wanxo sk'och stiempoal yik ol ex k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán, yik tz'ochkan lum lum chi' eyikok yuj Jehová ko Diosal. Ayik toxo ix eyik' lu'um, haxo he kajnaj t'a sat lum chi',
tzeyak'och t'a he k'ool he b'eyb'alan masanil cheknab'il swalkan tik t'ayex tiknaik.
